job.job_description:
Design, build, deploy and monitor AI applications end-to-end - chatbots, RAG-based assistants, document-intelligence pipelines, agentic workflows and internal tools.
Write clean, tested, production-grade Python code and participate actively in code reviews.
Build retrieval pipelines - chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking - and iterate based on evaluation results.
Integrate AI features with enterprise systems, APIs, databases and third-party platforms.
Work with self-hosted open-weight models alongside API-based models; choose the right tool for the job based on cost, latency, privacy and quality.
Instrument systems for latency (p50/p95), cost per request, memory and token usage, response quality and tool-call success rate - and act on what you measure.
Build evaluation harnesses before shipping - not eyeball outputs.
Contribute to fine-tuning and model-adaptation experiments under senior guidance.
Sit with business users to understand real workflows and translate them into working prototypes quickly.
Own on-call for what you ship; document your work so it can be handed off, extended and maintained.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
